seed: Express the mechanics as pairwise interactions between types with named guards, such as blocking, pushing, collecting or toggling, and derive single-type rules from them.

synth.notes:
Word-edit game: cursor (player) moves to prev/next editable glyph column on ACTION3/ACTION4 with wraparound.
ACTION1/ACTION2 edit the glyph under the cursor, but the schema has no pixels, so nothing changes.
Legends, reference targets, glyphs and move_counter stay the same.
Stateless, so no continuity gating is needed.
Unconfirmed: whether glyph edits or the counter can ever change visible fields.
